description: This file implements a Redux middleware for logging user interactions and events within the Superset frontend, including navigation, dashboard interactions, and SQL Lab activities. It manages event queuing and sending via beacon or POST requests.

classes.name: LogEventData
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of log event data sent to the backend.

classes.name: LogEventAction
classes.description: Redux action interface for logging events, extending the base Action with specific payload.

classes.name: ExploreState
classes.description: Interface representing the explore state, particularly the current slice.

classes.name: SqlLabState
classes.description: Interface representing the SQL Lab state, including query editors and tab history.

classes.name: LoggerRootState
classes.description: Interface representing the root state of the logger, including dashboard, explore, SQL Lab, and impression info.

classes.name: LoggerStore
classes.description: Interface for the store used by the middleware, providing getState and dispatch methods.

methods.name: sendBeacon
methods.description: Function to send log events to the server using navigator.sendBeacon or fallback to POST.

methods.name: loggerMiddleware
methods.description: Redux middleware that intercepts LOG_EVENT actions, enriches event data with context, and queues events for sending.
